title: Added the ability to draw directly on the sheet: a wall, an enemy-crossing-out mark, or an ink puddle.
author: sketchbookidletower

comments.author: eteshnik
comments.body: The enemies and the tower are the same color—it's a bit hard on the eyes.

replies.author: sketchbookidletower
replies.body: You are right. I will think about how to fix this.

replies.author: IsaakAshby
replies.body:
Red enemies would be a pretty easy tell. Bright, very standard in gaming culture, and for our colorblind folks would still be very easy to differentiate.

comments.author: AshlaStudios
comments.body: Very creative take on finding an art style, solves the issue of the game not looking as if it was made by AI. Curious to hear on how you came up with it, what was your back and forth process with AI on asset creating and defining visuals in general.

comments.author: Affectionate_Fact854
comments.body:
Very cool concept taking in screen drawing patterns to another dimension with this :0

I wanted to do something similar of being able to draw patterns and it executing actions for my game 

But I did not know where to start, how to keep it at a low cpu usage and how I would actually implement it or scale it

So I just brushed it under the rug
